description: List the RSS / blog feeds connected in Flomixy, each with its newest items (id, title, link, status new/drafted/ignored, postStatus). Use a feed id + item id (or the item link) with generate_posts_from_rss_item to turn a blog article into social posts. Requires scope ACCOUNTS_READ.

itemsPerFeed.description: Newest items to return per feed (default 5, max 20).

name: list_rss_feeds
title: List RSS / blog feeds
